title: A note on "The volume of random simplices from elliptical distributions in high dimension"
summary: Recent work by Gusakova et al. (Stochastic Process. Appl. 164 (2023) 357-382) has shown a central and a stable limit theorem for the logarithmic volume of random simplices and random convex bodies under an elliptical framework in the high dimensional regime, that is, if p and n tend to infinity in such a way that the ratio tends to γwithin (0,1).
